name: one arm push-up negative
description: The lowering half of a one-arm push-up on the floor. It builds strength in the bottom range before you can press the full rep.
instructions: Set up in a plank with your feet wide and one hand under your chest.
Put your other hand behind your back.
Lower your chest slowly toward the floor, taking three to five seconds.
Keep your hips square and do not let your body twist.
Drop to your knees at the bottom, reset and repeat.
